completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_4906_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Barrios Anunang, Calawagan, Colorado, Dipacamo, Edcor, Guam, Nakar, Palawan, Progreso, San Francisco, San Mariano Norte, San Mariano Sur, Villa Rose, Villa Sanchez, and Villa Teresita in the Municipality of Angadanan; and barrios Aringay, Dingading, San Francisco, and Sinalugan in the Municipality of Echague, all in the Province of Isabela, are separated from said municipalities and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality, to be known as the Municipality of San Guillermo, same province. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in the present site of Barrio Edcor.
The first mayor, vice-mayor and councilors of the new municipality shall be elected in the next general elections for the local officials.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
